items.2_unpulled_decision: plan_tool.py record-unpulled FILE --sha256 H. FILE is exactly {kind: 'stage1 unpulled outputs decision', host, jobs: [index...], reason, utc, recorded_by} (distinct non-negative integer indices; non-empty texts; utc in UTC and not in the future). Refused when the host is unknown or recorded done, its block is sealed, an index is not in its pulled JOB-DONE.json or is another job, the job is not complete with a unit and a 64-hex complete_sha256, the unit's COMPLETE.json is in the pulled tree, or another recorded decision names the job. Stored in plan.json records.unpulled (resolved path, SHA-256, host, sorted jobs, reason, utc, recorded_by, recorded_utc). Re-hashed at every use (record-done, block A's completion check, the seal, a later record-unpulled): the file must be at its path, unchanged, with the same host, jobs and reason. record-done HOST: a named job skips the COMPLETE.json check (its unit must still be absent) and is recorded status 'complete' with pulled: false and unpulled_decision_sha256 (status stays 'complete' so the never-re-run rule and every 'complete' check stay as they are). block_a_done no longer counts such a job; block_a_unpulled counts it as decided (label -> decision SHA-256); block_a_open subtracts done, not-run and unpulled. The seal adds not_pulled: [{host, index, job, unit, decision_sha256}], no file hash (and the tree holds no rescore/ file).
items.3_finisher: finisher.py light-checks every host whatever its role (else branch). Stage-1 roles: w1_18, cert, certify, job, diagnostics, arms (plan_tool build_block and host_record). Any other role is checked too (fail closed). Test: each of the six roles plus one unlisted role: verified-and-stopped with its verified.jsonl line; review-needed-stopped for a changed listed file, a JOB-DONE.json that is not ok, and a non-zero outer exit; the pod is stopped every time.
items.4_user_rerun_payment: plan_tool.py record-rerun-payment FILE --sha256 H. FILE is exactly {kind: 'stage1 user decision: pay re-runs beyond the contingency', user_words (verbatim), block, jobs: [{arm, seed}], amount_usd, utc, recorded_by} (arm a text, seed an integer, distinct; amount finite and above 0, not a boolean). Refused unless block is a funding group with a contingency in plan.json, not sealed, and each named run is in that contingency's not_rerun list and not yet paid. Stored in records.rerun_payments; re-hashed at every use. requeue HOST: when a recorded payment (the latest naming each run) names runs that an earlier move of HOST held as not re-run (not_rerun 'where' = 'requeue HOST' or 'defer HOST'; the job still not_started, crashed or deferred), requeue moves exactly those runs through move_open (never a completed job again, at most 4 counted jobs, the next unlaunched block host with room or a new host) and pays them as one unit with pay_user: rules.unit_rerun_cost_usd, refused when its cost in cents is above what the decision still covers (amount less its earlier payments); recorded in contingency.<group>.user_paid {unit, new_pod, cost_usd, cost_cents_usd, amount_usd, where, decision_sha256, utc}; logged as 'rerun-user-paid'; the deferral entry carries reason 'user-paid-rerun' and the decision's SHA-256; each moved job carries rerun_payment_sha256. The contingency's usd, remaining_usd, spent and not_rerun are unchanged. Without a payment, requeue is exactly as before (a-7: 'already deferred'). Regenerations, O-only passes, retrains, re-scores and W1-18 are refused on this route.

extra_fixes.record_done_model_states: Found while building the a-2 fixture from its JOB-DONE.json: job 18 (c0, unit-free) records 8 outputs under job-18/c0/train/states/ ending in .safetensors (e1: adapter, optimizer, rng; init: adapter, rng; q: adapter, optimizer, rng). The light pull excludes *.safetensors, and the pulled tree lists only state.json in those folders. The old record-done required every recorded output in the tree, so record-done a-2 would have refused at job 18 even with jobs 12-15 decided. Fix: record-done accepts a recorded .safetensors output that is absent (not a broken link) and records the count as states_on_pod on the job; one that is present must hash as recorded; every other missing output still refuses (tested both ways; mutant B15-29-any-missing-output-accepted killed). This is the finisher's existing light-check rule. B10's jobs (block B) record their regen states the same way, so this also prevents the same refusal there. The lead may reject it; the fallback is a full pull, which is impossible for a stopped a-2.
extra_fixes.backup: backup_records_stage1.py would have reported a-2's jobs 12-15 as missing ('complete in plan.json but its unit is not sealed') and c0's 8 states as 'recorded output(s) not staged' (exit 2). Now a job with pulled false and a 64-hex unpulled_decision_sha256 is listed with that mark and not required, and a unit-free job's model-weight outputs are left aside, as a unit's are (tested both ways). Limit: the backup reads plan.json's marks and does not re-hash the decision file itself.

alternatives: Item 2: a new job status 'complete_not_pulled' was rejected. Status stays 'complete' with a pulled:false mark, because every check that reads 'complete' must keep working: never re-run a completed job (complete_keys), block_complete, defer and requeue. The completion check reads the mark and counts the job as decided, re-hashing the decision.
Item 2: letting the decision also excuse missing outputs was rejected. The decision covers only the unit; the job's outputs (its ledger under job-I/) are pulled and still checked.
Item 4: an explicit requeue flag was rejected because the brief says 'requeue HOST' with the record. The route needs a recorded decision that names held runs; without one the old path runs unchanged.

Item 4: payment from the contingency with a top-up of remaining_usd was rejected. It would mix the user's money into the frozen 1.25 contingency and change remaining_usd. user_paid is a separate list, and init-block's contingency recompute (sum of spent) never sees it.

Item 4: the cost is compared with amount_usd in cents ([D20] rounding: $9.4950 -> $9.49), so the FOCUS figure $9.49 covers the kit's unit. Comparing exact values would refuse a $9.49 record by half a cent.

Item 4: a later decision supersedes an earlier unpaid one for the runs it names (rather than one decision per run for ever), so the user can decide again on a new amount without editing a recorded file. Two decisions applying to one host's held runs refuse (one decision per requeue).
Item 3: keeping a list of the six stage-1 roles was rejected. The light check is unconditional, so a host with an unexpected role is checked too and never passes unchecked as 'stopped'.
No change to stage1_rules.py or the job runner: both are packed to pods, and an edit would need a re-pack before a-7's replacement launches. Their SHA-256 are unchanged (unchanged_files).
